snippet.title: Announcing Tiny Aquarium Mobile!
snippet.description:
A happy aquarium that lives on your phone! Tiny Aquarium Mobile is a social idle simulator that keeps growing, even when offline. Hatch, sell fish, decorate, go fishin’, and visit your friends’ aquariums with bite-sized daily sessions.

Now available on App Store...
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiny-aquarium-mobile/id6756265699

...and on Google Play!
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lunheim.tinyaquarium&hl=en
